business: Bracket, a one-person software house based in Kuwait that builds websites, AI booking agents, SEO and GEO for UK small businesses, remotely
target: Owners of small local businesses in Greater Manchester (cafés, salons, barbers, clinics, gyms, trades, estate agents, small shops) who have no website or one they're unhappy with

segments.name: Sole trader or micro business (1-3 people; income = yearly turnover in GBP)
Small team business (4-15 staff; income = yearly turnover in GBP)
Established local business (15-40 staff; income = yearly turnover in GBP)

behaviours.name: Gets three quotes
behaviours.how: Always asks three local firms for quotes and picks the middle one.

behaviours.name: Burned before
behaviours.how: Paid a web designer before and the site was late, unfinished or held hostage; trusts nobody now.

behaviours.name: DIY first
behaviours.how: Built their own page on Wix or uses a Fresha/Booksy page and Instagram, and thinks that's enough.

behaviours.name: Word of mouth only
behaviours.how: Only hires people a friend or another local owner recommends.

behaviours.name: Reads every review
behaviours.how: Checks Google and Trustpilot reviews before contacting anyone.

behaviours.name: Wants it done for them
behaviours.how: Too busy to deal with tech; happy to pay if someone else handles it all.

behaviours.name: Price first
behaviours.how: Picks the cheapest option that looks good enough.

objections: They're in Kuwait, not Manchester: what if they disappear with my deposit?
No reviews and no past clients to look at
I already have a Wix page or a Fresha booking page
A local freelancer would do it for less
An AI agent talking to my customers could get things wrong
Hidden extras later, or I won't own my site
I don't have time to write the content and answer their questions
Paying a monthly fee on top of the build
habits: you take most enquiries on WhatsApp and Instagram DMs
customers mostly find you on Google Maps
you answer messages late at night after closing
you've had a web designer cold-call or DM you this month
you pay your accountant and suppliers by bank transfer, not PayPal
you're in a local business Facebook group where people swap recommendations
